WITH input AS (
  SELECT
    NULLIF('{{ $("Нормализовать вход").item.json.lead_external_id }}','') AS ext_primary_id,
    NULLIF('{{ $("Нормализовать вход").item.json.contact_external_id }}','') AS ext_contact_id,
    NULLIF('{{ $("Нормализовать вход").item.json.lead_external_id }}','') AS ext_deal_id,
    NULLIF('{{ $("Нормализовать вход").item.json.conversation_external_id }}','') AS ext_conv_id,
    NULLIF('{{ $("Нормализовать вход").item.json.raw_payload["message[add][0][id]"] }}','') AS ext_msg_id,
    '{{ $("Нормализовать вход").item.json.channel }}' AS chan,
    COALESCE(NULLIF('{{ $("Нормализовать вход").item.json.timestamp }}','')::timestamptz, NOW()) AS msg_ts,
    '{{ $("Нормализовать вход").item.json.message_text }}' AS raw_txt,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'amo_subdomain', '{{ $("Нормализовать вход").item.json.source_metadata.amo_account }}',
      'amo_account_id', '{{ $("Нормализовать вход").item.json.source_metadata.amo_account_id }}',
      'talk_id', '{{ $("Нормализовать вход").item.json.source_metadata.talk_id }}',
      'author_id', '{{ $("Нормализовать вход").item.json.source_metadata.author_id }}',
      'element_type', '{{ $("Нормализовать вход").item.json.source_metadata.element_type }}',
      'contact_id', '{{ $("Нормализовать вход").item.json.contact_external_id }}',
      'author_name', '{{ $("Нормализовать вход").item.json.source_metadata.author_name }}'
    ) AS s_meta,
    '{{ JSON.stringify($node["Webhook1"].json.body) }}'::jsonb AS raw_webhook_body
),
lead_upsert AS (
  INSERT INTO public.leads (
    external_primary_id,
    crm_contact_id,
    crm_deal_id,
    source_channel,
    source_metadata,
    last_inbound_at,
    name
  )
  SELECT
    ext_primary_id, ext_contact_id, ext_deal_id, chan, s_meta, msg_ts, s_meta->>'author_name'
  FROM input
  ON CONFLICT (external_primary_id)
  DO UPDATE SET
    last_inbound_at = EXCLUDED.last_inbound_at,
    source_metadata = EXCLUDED.source_metadata,
    crm_contact_id = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.crm_contact_id, public.leads.crm_contact_id),
    crm_deal_id = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.crm_deal_id, public.leads.crm_deal_id)
  RETURNING id
),
identity_upsert AS (
  INSERT INTO public.channel_identities (lead_id, channel, external_contact_id, external_conversation_id)
  SELECT lead_upsert.id, input.chan, input.ext_contact_id, input.ext_conv_id
  FROM lead_upsert, input
  ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
),
conv_upsert AS (
  INSERT INTO public.conversations (lead_id, channel, external_conversation_id, last_message_at)
  SELECT lead_upsert.id, input.chan, input.ext_conv_id, input.msg_ts
  FROM lead_upsert, input
  ON CONFLICT (external_conversation_id)
  DO UPDATE SET last_message_at = EXCLUDED.last_message_at
  RETURNING id, lead_id
),
run_insert AS (
  INSERT INTO public.workflow_runs (lead_id, workflow_name, trigger_type, status, input_payload_json, started_at)
  SELECT lead_upsert.id, '01_Ingress_Channel_Intake', 'webhook', 'started', input.raw_webhook_body, NOW()
  FROM lead_upsert, input
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT
  l.id AS lead_id,
  c.id AS conversation_id,
  NULL::bigint AS message_id,
  r.id AS run_id
FROM lead_upsert l
CROSS JOIN conv_upsert c
CROSS JOIN run_insert r;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    md5(
      COALESCE('{{ $json.channel }}','') || '|' ||
      COALESCE('{{ $json.contact_external_id }}','') || '|' ||
      COALESCE('{{ $json.timestamp }}','') || '|' ||
      COALESCE('{{ $json.normalized_text }}','')
    ) AS dedup_key
),
ins AS (
  INSERT INTO public.processed_events (dedup_key, platform, channel, session_id)
  SELECT (SELECT dedup_key FROM base), 'amocrm', '{{ $json.channel }}', '{{ $json.conversation_external_id }}'
  ON CONFLICT (dedup_key) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ins) THEN false ELSE true END AS is_duplicate;

BEGIN;

WITH src AS (
  SELECT
    {{ Number($json.lead_id ?? 0) }} AS lead_id,
    {{ Number($json.conversation_id ?? 0) }} AS conversation_id,
    {{ Number($json.run_id ?? 0) }} AS run_id,

    NULLIF('{{ String($("Нормализовать вход").first().json.platform ?? "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}', '') AS platform,
    NULLIF('{{ String($("Нормализовать вход").first().json.channel ?? "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}', '') AS channel,
    NULLIF('{{ String($("Нормализовать вход").first().json.external_message_id ?? "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}', '') AS external_message_id,
    NULLIF('{{ String($("Нормализовать вход").first().json.timestamp ?? "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}', '')::timestamptz AS msg_ts,

    '{{ String(
      $("Prepare Text").isExecuted
        ? ($("Prepare Text").first().json.text ?? "")
        : (($("Нормализовать вход").first().json.message_text ?? "") || ($("Нормализовать вход").first().json.normalized_text ?? ""))
    ).replace(/'/g, "''") }}' AS final_text,

    '{{ JSON.stringify($("Нормализовать вход").first().json.attachments ?? []).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb AS attachments_json,

    CASE
      WHEN '{{ String((($("Нормализовать вход").first().json.attachments ?? [])[0]?.type) ?? "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}' = 'voice' THEN 'voice_transcribed'
      WHEN '{{ String((($("Нормализовать вход").first().json.attachments ?? [])[0]?.type) ?? "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}' = 'document' THEN 'document'
      WHEN '{{ String((($("Нормализовать вход").first().json.attachments ?? [])[0]?.type) ?? "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}' = 'photo' THEN 'photo'
      WHEN '{{ String((($("Нормализовать вход").first().json.attachments ?? [])[0]?.type) ?? "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}' = 'video' THEN 'video'
      ELSE 'text'
    END AS final_message_type,

    '{{ JSON.stringify({
      execution_id: $execution.id,
      source_type: $("Нормализовать вход").first().json.source_metadata?.source_type ?? null,
      platform: $("Нормализовать вход").first().json.platform ?? null,
      channel: $("Нормализовать вход").first().json.channel ?? null,
      is_voice: (( $("Нормализовать вход").first().json.attachments ?? [])[0]?.type ?? '') === 'voice'
    }).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb AS event_payload,

    '{{ JSON.stringify($json).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb AS result_payload
),

existing_message AS (
  SELECT m.id
  FROM public.messages m, src
  WHERE src.external_message_id IS NOT NULL
    AND m.external_message_id = src.external_message_id
  LIMIT 1
),

updated_message AS (
  UPDATE public.messages m
  SET
    text = src.final_text,
    message_type = src.final_message_type,
    attachments_json = src.attachments_json,
    updated_at = NOW()
  FROM src
  WHERE m.id IN (SELECT id FROM existing_message)
  RETURNING m.id
),

inserted_message AS (
  INSERT INTO public.messages (
    lead_id,
    conversation_id,
    channel,
    direction,
    message_type,
    text,
    attachments_json,
    sent_by,
    source_workflow,
    external_message_id,
    created_at
  )
  SELECT
    src.lead_id,
    src.conversation_id,
    src.channel,
    'inbound',
    src.final_message_type,
    src.final_text,
    src.attachments_json,
    'client',
    '01_Ingress_Channel_Intake',
    src.external_message_id,
    COALESCE(src.msg_ts, NOW())
  FROM src
  WHERE src.lead_id > 0
    AND src.conversation_id > 0
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM existing_message)
  RETURNING id
),

final_message AS (
  SELECT id FROM updated_message
  UNION ALL
  SELECT id FROM inserted_message
  LIMIT 1
),

event_insert AS (
  INSERT INTO public.lead_events (
    lead_id,
    event_type,
    event_category,
    workflow_name,
    status,
    payload
  )
  SELECT
    src.lead_id,
    'ingress_finished',
    'ingress',
    '01_Ingress_Channel_Intake',
    'success',
    src.event_payload
  FROM src
  WHERE src.lead_id > 0
  RETURNING id
),

run_update AS (
  UPDATE public.workflow_runs wr
  SET
    status = 'completed',
    finished_at = NOW(),
    result_payload_json = src.result_payload
  FROM src
  WHERE wr.id = src.run_id
    AND src.run_id > 0
  RETURNING wr.id
)

SELECT
  src.lead_id,
  src.conversation_id,
  src.run_id,
  (SELECT id FROM final_message) AS message_id
FROM src;

COMMIT;

WITH input AS (
  SELECT
    NULLIF('{{ String($("Нормализовать вход").first().json.platform ?? "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}', '') AS platform,
    NULLIF('{{ String($("Нормализовать вход").first().json.channel ?? "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}', '') AS channel,
    NULLIF('{{ String($("Нормализовать вход").first().json.contact_external_id ?? "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}', '') AS ext_contact_id,
    NULLIF('{{ String($("Нормализовать вход").first().json.conversation_external_id ?? "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}', '') AS ext_conv_id,
    NULLIF('{{ String($("Нормализовать вход").first().json.external_message_id ?? "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}', '') AS ext_msg_id,
    NULLIF('{{ String($("Нормализовать вход").first().json.source_metadata?.author_username ?? "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}', '') AS author_username,
    NULLIF('{{ String($("Нормализовать вход").first().json.lead_external_id ?? "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}', '') AS ext_lead_id,
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF('{{ String($("Нормализовать вход").first().json.timestamp ?? "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}', '')::timestamptz,
      NOW()
    ) AS msg_ts,
    '{{ String($("Нормализовать вход").first().json.message_text ?? "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}' AS raw_txt,
    '{{ String($("Нормализовать вход").first().json.normalized_text ?? "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}' AS normalized_txt,
    '{{ JSON.stringify($("Нормализовать вход").first().json.attachments ?? []).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb AS attachments_json,
    '{{ JSON.stringify($("Нормализовать вход").first().json.source_metadata ?? {}).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb AS source_meta,
    '{{ JSON.stringify($("Нормализовать вход").first().json.raw_payload ?? {}).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb AS raw_payload,
    CASE
      WHEN '{{ String((($("Нормализовать вход").first().json.attachments ?? [])[0]?.type) ?? "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}' = 'voice' THEN 'voice'
      WHEN '{{ String((($("Нормализовать вход").first().json.attachments ?? [])[0]?.type) ?? "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}' = 'document' THEN 'document'
      WHEN '{{ String((($("Нормализовать вход").first().json.attachments ?? [])[0]?.type) ?? "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}' = 'photo' THEN 'photo'
      WHEN '{{ String((($("Нормализовать вход").first().json.attachments ?? [])[0]?.type) ?? "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}' = 'video' THEN 'video'
      ELSE 'text'
    END AS msg_type,
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF('{{ String($("Нормализовать вход").first().json.lead_external_id ?? "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}', ''),
      NULLIF('{{ String($("Нормализовать вход").first().json.contact_external_id ?? "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}', ''),
      md5(
        COALESCE('{{ String($("Нормализовать вход").first().json.platform ?? "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}', '') || '|' ||
        COALESCE('{{ String($("Нормализовать вход").first().json.channel ?? "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}', '') || '|' ||
        COALESCE('{{ String($("Нормализовать вход").first().json.conversation_external_id ?? "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}', '')
      )
    ) AS stable_lead_key
),
lead_upsert AS (
  INSERT INTO public.leads (
    external_primary_id,
    crm_contact_id,
    crm_deal_id,
    source_channel,
    source_metadata,
    last_inbound_at,
    name,
    username
  )
  SELECT
    stable_lead_key,
    CASE WHEN platform = 'amocrm' THEN ext_contact_id ELSE NULL END,
    CASE WHEN platform = 'amocrm' THEN ext_lead_id ELSE NULL END,
    channel,
    source_meta,
    msg_ts,
    COALESCE(source_meta->>'author_name', 'Guest'),
    author_username
  FROM input
  ON CONFLICT (external_primary_id)
  DO UPDATE SET
    last_inbound_at = EXCLUDED.last_inbound_at,
    source_channel = EXCLUDED.source_channel,
    source_metadata = COALESCE(public.leads.source_metadata, '{}'::jsonb) || EXCLUDED.source_metadata,
    crm_contact_id = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.crm_contact_id, public.leads.crm_contact_id),
    crm_deal_id = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.crm_deal_id, public.leads.crm_deal_id),
    name = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.name, public.leads.name),
    username = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.username, public.leads.username)
  RETURNING id
),
identity_upsert AS (
  INSERT INTO public.channel_identities (
    lead_id,
    channel,
    external_contact_id,
    external_conversation_id,
    is_primary,
    created_at,
    updated_at
  )
  SELECT
    lead_upsert.id,
    input.channel,
    input.ext_contact_id,
    input.ext_conv_id,
    true,
    NOW(),
    NOW()
  FROM lead_upsert, input
  ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
),
conv_upsert AS (
  INSERT INTO public.conversations (
    lead_id,
    channel,
    external_conversation_id,
    status,
    started_at,
    last_message_at,
    created_at,
    updated_at
  )
  SELECT
    lead_upsert.id,
    input.channel,
    input.ext_conv_id,
    'active',
    input.msg_ts,
    input.msg_ts,
    NOW(),
    NOW()
  FROM lead_upsert, input
  ON CONFLICT (external_conversation_id)
  DO UPDATE SET
    last_message_at = EXCLUDED.last_message_at,
    updated_at = NOW()
  RETURNING id, lead_id
),
conv_final AS (
  SELECT id, lead_id FROM conv_upsert
  UNION ALL
  SELECT c.id, c.lead_id
  FROM public.conversations c, input
  WHERE c.external_conversation_id = input.ext_conv_id
  LIMIT 1
),
message_insert AS (
  INSERT INTO public.messages (
    lead_id,
    conversation_id,
    channel,
    direction,
    message_type,
    text,
    attachments_json,
    sent_by,
    source_workflow,
    external_message_id,
    created_at
  )
  SELECT
    conv_final.lead_id,
    conv_final.id,
    input.channel,
    'inbound',
    input.msg_type,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(input.raw_txt, ''), input.normalized_txt),
    input.attachments_json,
    'client',
    '01_Ingress_Channel_Intake',
    input.ext_msg_id,
    input.msg_ts
  FROM conv_final, input
  ON CONFLICT (external_message_id)
  DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id
),
message_final AS (
  SELECT id FROM message_insert
  UNION ALL
  SELECT m.id
  FROM public.messages m, input
  WHERE input.ext_msg_id IS NOT NULL
    AND m.external_message_id = input.ext_msg_id
  LIMIT 1
),
run_insert AS (
  INSERT INTO public.workflow_runs (
    lead_id,
    workflow_name,
    trigger_type,
    status,
    input_payload_json,
    started_at
  )
  SELECT
    lead_upsert.id,
    '01_Ingress_Channel_Intake',
    'webhook',
    'started',
    raw_payload,
    NOW()
  FROM lead_upsert, input
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT
  lead_upsert.id AS lead_id,
  conv_final.id AS conversation_id,
  message_final.id AS message_id,
  run_insert.id AS run_id
FROM lead_upsert
CROSS JOIN conv_final
CROSS JOIN run_insert
LEFT JOIN message_final ON true;
